title: P1: Reward-trained symbolic residuals on the qualified reference
hypothesis: Action-level reward credit assignment will learn sparse state-conditioned corrections to the frozen D-072-qualified controller that improve sustained axial-rolling success more than independent parameter draws.

prediction.against: the independent-parameter-draw arm's finalists, matched by training block and fresh case (384 pairs)
prediction.rationale:
Primary: PPO minus independent draws on deterministic fresh evaluation, targeting five percentage points of sustained-success gain. Also preregister PPO versus ARS and all three arms versus the qualified reference; apply Holm correction across these five contrasts for positive-effect claims. An interval excluding zero establishes a positive difference, not necessarily a difference exceeding 0.05.

Reference and controls: reconstruct D-058 plus JointMotionResidual from R-102's exact recorded selected configuration, verifying hash 2a509ef5ffc148cab2a513bc2c7339cca9a620b50dec2f7a988fd2b041c58cd1. Save an experiment-local descriptor with source, state and config hashes; leave config/pen_spin/d058_fixed_stroke_incumbent/ unchanged. Do not tune on R-102's cases. This tests a new state-conditioned residual and policy gradients, not the old scalar-tuning comparison or another replication of R-102.

Common actor: action = clamp(reference_action + residual_theta(features), -1, 1), with one frozen sparse feature-to-joint map containing 20–40 zero-initialized coefficients. Candidate inputs are normalized joint velocity, fixed filtered velocity, posture error, centering error and unsigned axial-rate error. Agree and freeze the exact map, coefficient bounds, residual cap, normalization procedure and all optimizer/exploration settings through triage before simulator spending. Freeze normalization from training-only reference rollouts; keep the reference and filter constants fixed. No trainable memory, contact-frame decoder, expert fitting or controller-generation calls.

Arms: independent parameter draws, ARS chosen prospectively as the parameter-space learner, and PPO with the identical symbolic actor and a neural critic. Share coefficient bounds, initial deterministic policy, features, action constraints, reward and seeded training reset distribution within each block. Record exploration differences rather than claiming identical realized trajectories. Training uses one persistent Isaac process per arm/block with continuous auto-reset placements disjoint from every evaluation manifest. Every parameter-ranking rollout counts toward the arm's 500,000-transition budget. Three blocks per arm give 4.5 million training transitions; no automatic extensions.

Smoke gate: allow 256 episodes total for training-only reference normalization and runner/interface checks using seed 4763. Verify bit-identical zero-residual reference actions, nonzero executed authority, checkpoint reconstruction, finite likelihoods/gradients and per-environment reset of every velocity-filter state. PPO must save the sampled latent action used in its likelihood and use a documented latent-action or bounded-distribution contract, never a Gaussian density evaluated on already clipped actions. Freeze one dense reward formula and its coefficients through triage: retained, centered unsigned axial rolling with bounded speed reward, fall penalty and modest action cost. No reward variants selected from fresh outcomes. Stop on a failed correctness gate.

Selection and evaluation: evaluate checkpoints at 0, 100,000, 200,000, 300,000, 400,000 and 500,000 aggregate transitions for every arm/block. Choose one deterministic checkpoint per arm/block by selection sustained success, then tail-hit fraction, then fewer drops, then earlier checkpoint. Each evaluation runs one whole frozen manifest in a fresh Isaac process, with identical batch shape and case layout across paired arms. Use one 64-case selection manifest and one 128-case fresh pilot manifest per block; evaluate the reference on both. This totals 5,184 evaluation episodes and 69 evaluation processes. Do not select a preferred training block using fresh outcomes.

Keep Stage 3 at 60 Hz and 360 steps; sustained success requires no fall and the centered/absolute-spin predicate on every final-60 step. Report paired intervals, manifest-level uncertainty, per-block scores, wins/losses/ties, drop differences and one-sided 95% upper bounds, tail-hit fraction, failure categories, curves, symbolic complexity, transitions, actual episodes, optimizer updates, wall time and calls/tokens by role. Report proposed versus executed residual norms and saturation per joint, especially MFJ2 and LFJ1. Preserve per-case records, hashes, full configuration and reconstructable checkpoints; write metrics and controls to research_result.json with artifact paths and deviations.

Dependencies and stopping: implement the missing study handler and registry entry before treating the command as runnable; reuse the existing dispatcher, incumbent residual and established evaluator. Read the cited decision artifacts before triage. This finite pilot cannot promote a controller or open P2 by itself. A subsequent separately preregistered confirmation must freeze its finalist, reserve unused seeds and prospectively size disjoint cases from pilot discordance for a 0.05 effect. Advancement requires the repository's strict positive paired-success interval and a challenger-minus-reference drop-rate one-sided 95% upper bound <= 0.05. Never repeat confirmation until an interval becomes favorable. If clipping removes proposed changes, investigate authority before spending more training; if changes execute but learning fails, examine representation/objective mismatch rather than declaring reward learning impossible. Follow existing escalation/exhaustion and state-regeneration, handoff, commit and push requirements.

FROZEN CONFIGURATION (triage round 1, agreed revise; nothing below may change after approval; every constant is also in the config block `symbolic_reward_residual`, whose canonical JSON hash is recorded in the smoke record before any training).

REFERENCE. The D-058 incumbent (config/pen_spin/d058_fixed_stroke_incumbent, unchanged) plus JointMotionResidual with the config's `incumbent_residual.selected` values, verified against selected_sha256 2a509ef5ffc148cab2a513bc2c7339cca9a620b50dec2f7a988fd2b041c58cd1. Descriptor config/pen_spin/symbolic_reward_reference/reference.json records the incumbent asset file hashes, the residual parameters and hash, the hash of incumbent_residual.py and the source decisions; the study refuses to run if any of them differs. Its per-joint velocity filter is the only controller state; the training wrapper re-initialises it per environment at every auto-reset.

COMMON DETERMINISTIC ACTOR (32 coefficients theta, all zero initially; action order = the 20 actuated joints WRJ1 WRJ0 FFJ3 MFJ3 RFJ3 LFJ4 THJ4 FFJ2 MFJ2 RFJ2 LFJ3 THJ3 FFJ1 MFJ1 RFJ1 LFJ2 THJ2 LFJ1 THJ1 THJ0, asserted against the simulator's actuated joint names in the smoke):
  residual_j = clip( a_j * s  +  b_g(j) * vhat_j  +  c_g(j) * ehat_j , -0.10, +0.10 )      (normalised action units)
  action     = clamp( reference_action + residual, -1, 1 )
  s      = clip((7.0 - |axial rate|) / 7.0, 0, 1): the unsigned axial-rate deficit against Stage 3's target rate, from the observed pen quaternion and angular velocity (no roll sign).
  vhat_j = clip(v_f,j / (3 rms_v,j), -1, 1): the reference's own filtered joint velocity (rad/s; same filter constant, no new state).
  ehat_j = clip((reference_action_j - q_j) / (3 rms_e,j), -1, 1): posture error of the reference's target against the normalised joint position.
  a_j: 20 coefficients (a slow-spin-gated posture offset per joint); b_g, c_g: 6 + 6 coefficients shared within the joint groups wrist {WRJ1,WRJ0}, FF {FFJ3,FFJ2,FFJ1}, MF {MFJ3,MFJ2,MFJ1}, RF {RFJ3,RFJ2,RFJ1}, LF {LFJ4,LFJ3,LFJ2,LFJ1}, TH {THJ4,THJ3,THJ2,THJ1,THJ0}.
  Every coefficient is bounded to [-0.10, +0.10] (projection after every update / at every draw). rms_v and rms_e are per-joint root mean squares over the in-play steps of the smoke's 128 reference episodes (training seed 4763 only), floors 0.05 rad/s and 0.01, frozen in normalization.json before training. Centering error is not an input: the reference already carries a centering term, and the coefficient budget is spent on the slow-spin failure mode D-069 measured. theta = 0 gives reference_action + 0.0.

REWARD (one formula, all arms, per environment step, computed from the env's own centre distance d and axial rate w before any auto-reset):
  r = exp(-(d / 0.08)^2) * min(|w| / 6.0, 1)  -  5.0 * [the pen fell this step]  -  0.01 * mean_j((executed_action_j - reference_action_j) / 0.10)^2.
The sustained-success rule is unchanged and is never a training signal.

TRAINING (one persistent Isaac process per (arm, block); blocks 0,1,2 use seeds 4760,4761,4762 for the env's own reset RNG, torch and numpy; 128 environments in every arm; exactly 460,800 transitions per run = 4,147,200 in total, under the 4.5 M cap; every parameter-ranking rollout is inside that count). The run's transition count is fixed and does not depend on early terminations.
  Independent draws: 10 generations; each generation is a full env reset then 360 steps; 8 draws per generation, 16 environments each (80 draws). theta = rho * z, z ~ U[-0.10, 0.10]^32, rho log-uniform in [0.03, 1], from numpy default_rng(seed + 1000); no adaptation. A draw's score is the mean over its 16 environments of the summed reward over the 360 steps (an environment that falls is auto-reset and keeps counting). Nominee = best score so far (ties: earlier).
  ARS (V1-t, chosen now as the one parameter-space learner): 10 iterations, each a full env reset then 360 steps; 8 directions delta ~ N(0, I), antithetic pairs theta +/- nu*delta with nu = 0.02, 8 environments per candidate; top b = 4 directions by max(r+, r-); theta += alpha / (b * sigma_R) * sum((r+ - r-) * delta) with alpha = 0.02 and sigma_R the standard deviation of the 2b used returns; then projection. Nominee = the current theta.
  PPO: the same symbolic mean mu(theta) = reference_action + residual (not clamped to [-1,1]); latent action u ~ N(mu, 0.05^2 I) with a FIXED standard deviation (exploration only, not part of the deployed actor); the stored variable and the likelihood are those of u; the environment executes clamp(u, -1, 1) (the clamp is part of the environment, so no density is ever evaluated on a clipped action). Deterministic deployment is clamp(mu, -1, 1). 120 updates of 30 steps x 128 environments (3,840 transitions) with continuous auto-reset; gamma 0.99, lambda 0.95, no bootstrap at a fall, V(s_t) bootstrap at a time-out; clip 0.2; 4 epochs x 4 minibatches; advantages normalised per batch; actor Adam on theta/0.10 with initial rate 3e-3, adapted by the measured KL to a 0.01 target within [3e-4, 3e-2] (x1.5 / /1.5), projection after each step; no entropy term; critic MLP (157-d observation, running normalisation; 256-256-128 ELU; value scaled by 10) with Adam 1e-3, updates 1-5 train the critic only. Nominee = the current theta.
  Features, reference action and filter state are stored per step for the update; nothing parameter-dependent is hidden (no trainable memory).

SMOKE GATE (seed 4763, one process, 128 environments, 720 steps = 256 episode equivalents; training-only native resets; stops the study on any failure, before training):
  (1) zero-theta identity: the training wrapper's action equals an independently constructed JointMotionResidual's action bit for bit on every environment-step before that environment's first reset (mismatches = 0);
  (2) per-environment filter reset: at each auto-reset the reset environments' filter equals their current velocity and no other environment's filter changes (violations = 0);
  (3) normalisation statistics frozen from steps 0-359 (reference only);
  (4) executed authority (steps 360-719, after a full reset): probe theta with every coefficient at +/-0.05 (signs from default_rng(4763)); pass needs the fraction of environment-steps whose executed action differs from the reference >= 0.90, the pooled ratio sum|executed residual| / sum|proposed residual| >= 0.50, and at least 15 of 20 joints with a ratio >= 0.25; per-joint proposed and executed norms and saturation are reported, MFJ2 and LFJ1 by name;
  (5) likelihood: for sampled latent actions the log-density is finite, the importance ratio at unchanged theta is exactly 1, and the surrogate's gradient is finite and nonzero for all 32 coefficients;
  (6) reconstruction: a saved checkpoint, reloaded through the evaluation controller factory, reproduces the recorded deterministic actions on a stored observation sequence bit for bit; every evaluation cell reports its theta hash, which must equal the training record's;
  (7) throughput: if the measured rate implies more than 4 h for the whole protocol, stop and return to triage.

SELECTION AND FRESH EVALUATION (established evaluator: one whole frozen manifest per fresh Isaac process). Checkpoints after 92,160 x k transitions, k = 1..5 (generations 2,4,6,8,10; PPO updates 24,48,72,96,120). Step 0 is the reference itself and is evaluated once per block. Block b's selection manifest (64 cases; seeds 4764,4765,4766) scores the reference and the 15 nominees (a nominee identical to an already scored one reuses that cell). Rule per (arm, block): most sustained successes, then higher tail-hit fraction, then fewer drops, then the earlier checkpoint (step 0 may win and is recorded as 'training rejected'). The nine finalists are hashed and frozen in finalists.json before any fresh case; block b's fresh manifest (128 cases; seeds 4767,4768,4769) scores the reference and that block's three finalists. At most 48 + 12 = 60 evaluation processes and 3,072 + 1,536 = 4,608 evaluation episodes.

INFERENCE. For each contrast, d = the case-paired difference of sustained success on the fresh manifests, matched by block and case (384 pairs). Estimate = the mean of the three block means (equal block sizes, so the pooled mean). Two uncertainties are reported and never merged: (i) conditional on the nine trained finalists, the paired t interval over 384 case differences (and the win/loss/tie table); (ii) across training runs, the t interval over the three block means (2 degrees of freedom), which is the only statement about the learner rather than these finalists and is expected to be wide. The registered prediction is judged on (i) as written in falsified_by; a claim that a LEARNER beats another additionally needs (ii) to exclude zero, and otherwise the result is described as about these finalists only. Six planned contrasts in one Holm family at 0.05 on the two-sided case-paired t tests: PPO - draws (primary), PPO - ARS, ARS - draws, PPO - reference, ARS - reference, draws - reference; a positive-effect claim needs a Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 and a positive mean. Drop differences get the one-sided 95% upper bound against 0.05 for each arm against the reference. No promotion follows from this pilot.

BUDGET. Training 4,147,200 transitions = 11,520 episode equivalents; with the reference's roughly 5% drop rate and exploration, at most about 13,500 episodes are started. Smoke 256 equivalents; evaluation at most 4,608. Estimate 16,400 episode equivalents, ceiling 20,000 episodes started. Stopping rules, the same for every arm (triage round 2): (a) a smoke or training child that fails after it has started leaves a 'started' marker; the driver never relaunches it, stops the protocol, keeps its artifacts and returns to triage (no same-seed rerun, no replacement block); (b) 20,000 simulator episodes STARTED is a hard protocol-wide ceiling counting the smoke, initial placements, forced resets, auto-resets and every evaluation case: before each training run the driver reserves the 4,608-episode evaluation allowance and gives the child the remaining allowance as a cap, the child stops when its next reset would exceed it, and the protocol then stops with an incomplete result rather than extending or shortening any single arm; (c) a non-finite value stops the run under rule (a). No extension, no rerun for significance. Zero controller-generation LLM calls.

falsified_by: The predicted magnitude is refuted if the fresh deterministic PPO-minus-independent-draws paired-success interval has upper bound below 0.05; an upper bound <= 0 additionally refutes a positive advantage at this budget. An interval containing both zero and 0.05 is inconclusive, and reward-only gains do not establish task improvement. A failed identity, likelihood, reset or executed-authority check invalidates the comparison rather than testing the learning hypothesis.

result.notes: INCOMPLETE: two of three blocks (256 fresh pairs per contrast, not 384). Deviations: (1) the first smoke (seed 4763) failed its joint-order gate because the implementer's check compared against env.cfg.actuated_joint_names (config order) instead of the executed sorted order; only that comparison was fixed and, by the user's decision after advisor consult call_00222, the smoke was rerun once on new seed 4770 and passed all seven gates; 4763 is spent. (2) Training stopped on the hard 20,000-episode ceiling at b2_draws (230,272 of 460,800 transitions): the implementer under-estimated starts per run (about 2,563 for draws/ARS, because each generation's forced reset is followed by a time-out auto-reset of every surviving environment; 1,435 for PPO). Block 2 is void (seed 4762 spent; manifests 4766 and 4769 retired unused). By advisor consult call_00224, recorded in amendment_two_blocks.json before any selection case, blocks 0 and 1 (each arm exactly 460,800 transitions, five checkpoints) were evaluated under the unchanged rules; no training was extended, rerun or replaced. b2_draws overran its allowance by 38 starts into the evaluation reserve. Charged starts 17,926 of 20,000 (evaluation charged per case as agreed at triage; the evaluator physically places about three episodes per case, reported, not charged). Evaluation used 32 processes and 2,496 cases, fewer than scheduled, because identical nominees reuse a cell (draws' best-so-far nominee did not change after its first or second checkpoint) and b0_ars selected step 0 (training rejected: its fresh cell is the reference's, difference exactly 0 in that block). The two-block t interval has 1 degree of freedom and is reported as computed. Selection-manifest gains did not carry to fresh: b0 PPO checkpoint 1 scored 38/64 against the reference's 32/64 on selection and 58/128 against 59/128 on fresh. ARS and PPO both pushed coefficients to the 0.10 bound; executed residuals stay close to proposed ones (authority is not the limit). Training-return curves are in each train.json and are not task evidence. Reward-only movement (PPO mean step reward about 0.33 to 0.37 under exploration noise) did not become sustained success.

verdicts.reasoning: Incomplete: two of three blocks. The registered contrast, PPO minus independent draws on fresh deterministic evaluation, is +0.004 with a case-paired 95% interval [-0.059, +0.067] over 256 pairs (34 wins, 33 losses): it contains zero and +0.05, so by the registered falsified_by it is neither supported nor refuted. No contrast in the Holm family is positive (smallest adjusted p 0.62). No trained arm beats the qualified reference: PPO -0.043 [-0.103, +0.017], ARS +0.004 [-0.048, +0.056] (one of its two finalists is the reference itself, training rejected), draws -0.047 [-0.103, +0.010]. Every instrument check passed (identity, filter reset, authority 0.99 executed/proposed, likelihood, reconstruction), so this is not an authority failure: the residuals execute and do not help. Checkpoint selection on 64 cases picked noise (b0 PPO 38/64 vs 32/64 on selection, 58/128 vs 59/128 fresh). What it does not show: that reward learning cannot work in this family; each learner had two runs of 460,800 transitions and the two-block interval is uninformative.
verdicts.next_experiment: Do not extend R-103 and do not open P2 (no learner has a confirmed gain). The cheapest informative follow-up inside the direction is diagnostic, not more of the same: the selection instrument (64 cases) cannot rank checkpoints whose true differences are a few points, and both adaptive learners saturate the coefficient bound within a third of the budget while fresh success falls slightly, which points at objective mismatch (dense reward vs sustained success) or too-large steps rather than authority. Options for the advisor: (a) an offline/cheap audit of reward-versus-success alignment using the recorded training curves and the fresh cells already on disk; (b) a preregistered rerun with corrected episode accounting, a larger selection instrument and a smaller step/bound; (c) P4-style anchored component replacement if (a) says whole-residual learning is objective-limited.

direction: Continue Stage-3 Shadow Hand axial rolling by testing reward-trained symbolic residuals and incremental policy construction. Use the frozen D-072-qualified controller as the experimental reference, without changing the saved default incumbent. First compare independent parameter draws, ARS/CEM and PPO on one identical sparse, state-conditioned symbolic residual family. If an inner learner produces a confirmed useful gain, compare fixed structure, grammar-based structural evolution and LLM-guided structural evolution with that learner and inherited parameters. Investigate compact memory or anchored component replacement only when the preceding results motivate them. Preserve the task, frozen evaluation manifests and strict paired promotion/drop criteria. Run one protocol at a time. No controller-generation LLM calls during P1; advisor calls for the research loop remain allowed. Later controller-generation calls need an agreed protocol and explicit call budget. Do not repeat R-102, retune its confirmation cases, reopen cold whole-controller generation, or resume expert cloning. Continue evidence-driven follow-ups within this direction through the existing loop, including its escalation and exhaustion rules.

advisor.reasoning: This is the right next comparison: it tests reward-trained, state-conditioned corrections rather than repeating R-102's frozen-residual confirmation. However, the residual map, reward, optimizer settings and independent-draw ranking procedure remain unspecified despite requiring agreement before simulator spending. Three training blocks also require an explicit distinction between case-level uncertainty and evidence about learner performance across training runs. The proposed 20,000-episode estimate needs reconciliation with early resets and avoidable duplicate step-zero evaluations; controller-generation LLM cost should remain zero.

Make the training-only smoke gate operational: define numeric executed-authority pass thresholds, the perturbations used to measure them and deterministic checkpoint reconstruction checks. Stopping rules, the same for every arm (triage round 2): (a) a smoke or training child that fails after it has started leaves a 'started' marker; the driver never relaunches it, stops the protocol, keeps its artifacts and returns to triage (no same-seed rerun, no replacement block); (b) 20,000 simulator episodes STARTED is a hard protocol-wide ceiling counting the smoke, initial placements, forced resets, auto-resets and every evaluation case: before each training run the driver reserves the 4,608-episode evaluation allowance and gives the child the remaining allowance as a cap, the child stops when its next reset would exceed it, and the protocol then stops with an incomplete result rather than extending or shortening any single arm; (c) a non-finite value stops the run under rule (a). No extension, no rerun for significance. Zero controller-generation LLM calls.
